author: Dodging12
body:
Most people on this sub are playing Orna. I play HoA, and most of the HoA community is on the discord.  

One thing that I would say that echoes  a little bit is that it's hard to convince myself to play Aethric when I'm sitting at home where I could be playing PC/PS5/Switch games, but on the go or on the toilet it's fine. My main issue is that it's not deep enough of an rpg without the GPS component limiting how much content you can power through per day. I quickly realized that it was like doing the daily and weekly rep grinds in WoW, but without the fun and challenging dungeons and raids to make up for it. That, and the gacha-like FOMO events with all of their exclusive items kind of put me off. I'd rather play a normal A/RPG where I don't need to wait 6 months or something to get a build-enabling unique. I will say that if you enjoy grinding for the sake of it, this is a great option,and for a mobile game, the monetization is as good as you'll find.
